observations: Black standing fan with five blades and a circular wire cage.
Brand name 'QASA' is visible on the center hub of the fan in photo 1.
The fan is mounted on a grey telescopic pole with a circular base.
A power cord is visible extending from the base.
The fan is shown in a static position against a white wall and tiled floor.
Watermarks for 'Jiji' and 'TOY STORE' are present on the images.

claims.evidence: The brand is visible, but the 'rechargeable' feature cannot be confirmed from the static photos.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged
claims.evidence: Requires a video of the fan running on battery power.
Requires a video showing the fan running at low speed.

risks.risk: The fan may not be rechargeable or may have a dead battery.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on battery power alone.

risks.risk: The motor may be noisy or the oscillation mechanism may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running at all speeds with the oscillation switch engaged.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be degraded or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan running on battery power for at least 2 hours.

proof_requests: Video of the fan running on battery power to confirm it is rechargeable.
Video showing the fan oscillating and running at all speed settings.
Photo of the technical specification label on the base or motor housing.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
